avg8.equivalent_definition: mean of per-problem mean correctness across eight responses

maj8.definition: for each problem, count parsed normalized answers across eight responses; unique modal answer is the prediction; score exact normalized match to gold
maj8.parser_failures: do not vote; denominator remains 45 problems

method_matrix.selector: historical causal importance x positive local quantization-error reduction V2 -> V4

parser.parser_failure_policy: incorrect for Avg@8; contributes no A-E/source-answer vote for Maj@8
parser.strategy: prefer final boxed answer; otherwise explicit final answer line; no whole-CoT gold-informed search

patternkv_paper_amc24.reason: PatternKV exact AMC24 rows/protocol are unpublished; AMC24-Text-45 is an independent public benchmark

prompt.choices: not included; upstream public source has no choices field
prompt.duplicate_newline_prevention: assistant suffix is exactly '<think>\n' appended once after chat template generation prompt; no extra blank line is appended
prompt.user_prompt_template: {problem}\n\nPlease reason step by step, and put your final answer within \\boxed{}.

sampling.max_model_len: model/tokenizer context limit validated in runner before generation
sampling.stop_policy: use normalized tokenizer/model EOS token ids; record eos or length stop reason

seeds.pairing: same problem_id, response_id, and seed for every method
seeds.seed_source: new fixed 8-response list; no prior 8-response project seed list found

tie_policy.rationale: conservative, no arbitrary favorable tie-break, no seed-order dependency, no gold-informed selection
tie_policy.rule: if there is no unique modal parsed answer, Maj@8 prediction is unresolved and correctness is 0

truncation_policy.rule: if max_new_tokens is reached, parse the emitted text with the same parser; parsed answers score normally, parse failures are incorrect; no selective reruns
